meta.title: Today models
meta.description: Adds the models of the locally signed-in Today desktop app as a DSH provider named Today, and adds a Today page to Settings. The page shows the connected account, the plan and remaining usage allowance, the latest background tasks and diary, and the models with Today's own usage multiplier; it also lets you hide individual models, set a per-model context window, and change the turn timeout, poll interval, catalog refresh, default context window, concurrency, strict protocol and usage reporting. Changes are saved explicitly and take effect after the plugin restarts. Requirements and limits: the Today desktop app must be signed in on this machine, and the app's files are only read, never written. Today has no completion endpoint, so each turn is sent to Today's own agent through an isolated task conversation, which means the reply arrives complete rather than token by token, the agent's own personality and memory still shape the answer, and its own tools cannot be disabled from the API. The model choice is stored once per Today account rather than per conversation, so selecting a model in the composer also changes it in the Today app on your other devices; the default concurrency of one keeps turns from retargeting each other, and raising it trades that safety for throughput. Token counts are estimated because Today does not report them, while the plan usage shown on the page is Today's real reading. Turning the plugin off removes the provider and the Settings page and leaves the Today account untouched.
